prompt:
Original post-apocalyptic civilian resistance world. AMERICAN ACTION COMIC, late 1990s arcade fighting-game illustration. Bold confident BLACK INK contours, clean angular silhouettes, rich FLAT vibrant colors, large HARD-EDGED cel-shaded shadows, sparse printed halftone. Deep ink black and aubergine, vivid teal/cyan electronics, rusty orange and violet clothing, warm natural skin. NOT pencil sketchbook, NOT grayscale, NO dense scratchy crosshatching, NO photorealism, NO 3D, NO pixel art. Ordinary people with patched civilian clothes and improvised tools fight autonomous machines. NO medieval armor, swords, cloaks, runes, magic staffs, skeletons, goblins or monsters. No franchise characters, logos or superhero costumes. No text or UI baked in unless explicitly required. ONE four-character foreground cutout atlas, TWO columns by TWO rows1536x1024. Each768x512 cell contains exactly ONE machine attacking LEFT in one STATIC dramatic contact pose, same recognizable chassis as machine-sheet reference. Exact order top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right: lean biped security automaton with long improvised-looking rail launcher; squat four-legged chemical robot with big green pressurized tank; walking root-like tangle of industrial cables controlled by a small orange core; rail-maintenance biped robot with long steel spike and cyan sensor. Big head/sensors and weapon or claws, close framing. White thin outer outline around machine AND tool. All art fully within own cell with25px clear margin. No scene/floor/grid/text, TRUE transparent RGBA. No consecutive animation: FOUR DIFFERENT enemies. Four different machine closeups in a 2x2 grid, fully isolated transparent cells. Strong white cutout rim, selective action speed hatching, no opaque background panels. Faces and sensors visible, attacking toward LEFT.
NEW FINAL ART DIRECTION: original printed American action COMIC BOOK, this is a full REDRAW of the illustration. Strong expressive black ink outlines, angular purposeful shapes, two-tone cel shadows, vivid controlled hero accents on a dark violet/steel/petrol palette, visible Ben-Day halftone clusters and occasional dry ink. A clear THIN WHITE PAPER CUTOUT border around every person, machine, standalone object and icon silhouette. Comics cut-paper aesthetic, NOT 3D, NOT realistic painting, NOT pixel art, NOT generic airbrushed fantasy. Civilian survivors versus autonomous killing machines; retain their identities, jobs, workwear and improvised tools. No superhero costumes. The illustration must visibly feel like hand-inked printed comic art.
